description: Generate Laravel Eloquent model files (fillable, casts, and inferred relationships including belongsToMany through plain pivot tables) for a diagram.

dbml_source.description: Or export unsaved DBML text directly instead of a saved diagram.

diagram_id.description: A saved diagram to export (its UUID).

laravel_version.description: Target Laravel major version. 10 emits the legacy `protected $casts` property; 11+ emits the newer `casts(): array` method (not recognized by Eloquent 10).

name: export_laravel_models
